listening_script.text:
The MAIN IDEA is the most important point of a text.
DETAILS support the main idea with facts and examples.
How to Find the Main Idea:
1. Read the whole text first.
2. Ask: "What is this text MOSTLY about?"
3. Find the TOPIC SENTENCE (usually first or last sentence).
4. Check: Do the details support this idea?
Example Text:
"Butterflies are beautiful insects. They have colorful wings with
many patterns. Some butterflies are orange and black. Others are
blue or yellow. Butterflies make gardens look beautiful."
Main Idea: Butterflies are beautiful insects.
Details:
- They have colorful wings
- Some are orange and black
- Others are blue or yellow
- They make gardens beautiful
The details all support the main idea about butterflies being beautiful!
dictation: The MAIN IDEA is the most important point of a text.
DETAILS support the main idea with facts and examples.
